layers.name: Unwrapped phase
layers.unitsNote: Radians, per product attribute. Not a displacement. Colours show each value relative to its frame's median; the inspector shows the stored value.
layers.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/ISRO, NISAR; distributed by ASF DAAC
limitations: Phase is not displacement. No LOS conversion is applied: neither the specification nor the ATBD states the phase sign convention.
Pixels with component label 0 are masked: the ATBD says they could not be reliably unwrapped.
The estimated ionospheric phase screen is included in GUNW but not applied.
Frames 74 and 75 are unwrapped separately and are not mosaicked.
The 12-day interval cannot date a change or attribute its cause.

provenance.maskRule: Mask: water or invalid subswath masked, 255 no data. Phase only: component label 0 masked, 65535 no data.

layers.name: Ionosphere phase screen
layers.unitsNote: Radians. Colours are relative to each frame's median.
layers.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/ISRO, NISAR; distributed by ASF DAAC
limitations: An estimate published in the product. It is shown for comparison and is not applied to the phase here.
Low-frequency only, per the ATBD: small-scale ionospheric effects are not captured.

provenance.maskRule: Mask: water or invalid subswath masked, 255 no data. Phase only: component label 0 masked, 65535 no data.

layers.name: Phase with ionosphere screen removed
layers.unitsNote: Radians. Not a displacement. Colours are relative to each frame's median.
layers.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/ISRO, NISAR; distributed by ASF DAAC
limitations: Derived here: phase minus the published ionosphere screen. Not a product of the NISAR project.
The sign was chosen from the ATBD equation and confirmed by scatter on these frames, not from a stated convention.
The screen is low-frequency only, so smaller ionospheric effects remain. Troposphere and terrain effects also remain.
Still phase, not displacement.

provenance.maskRule: Mask: water or invalid subswath masked, 255 no data. Phase only: component label 0 masked, 65535 no data.

layers.name: Sentinel-1 damage proxy map (EOS-RS)
layers.attribution: Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026), processed by ESA. CC BY
limitations: Not NISAR. Sentinel-1 is a separate C-band mission.
A coloured picture with no measurement values, so the inspector cannot sample it.
EOS-RS calls it preliminary guidance. It may be less reliable over vegetated or mountainous areas, and scattered pixels there may be false positives.
A lack of coloured pixels does not necessarily mean an absence of damage.

layers.name: Sentinel-1 change screening (249 ha, REACH)
layers.attribution: IMPACT Initiatives / REACH, using Copernicus Sentinel-1 data. CC BY
limitations: Not NISAR. Sentinel-1 is a separate C-band mission.
Measures radar backscatter change, not structural damage. Debris, water, moisture, vegetation or clearance can all produce the signal, and damaged structures may show none.
Only assessed around pre-event built areas, so it says nothing about open ground.
